newsitem.title: USA: Harris unit orders Teradyne system.
newsitem.headline: Harris unit orders Teradyne system.

text.p: Teradyne Inc on Tuesday said that Harris Corp's Semiconductor unit has placed the initial order for test systems as part of a global replacement project.
Financial terms of the deal were not disclosed.

Teradyne said deliveries of the A567 advanced mixed-signal test systems will commence in the third quarter, with systems going first to Harris' Malaysian facility, where they will be used for production testing of commodity analog devices.
The A567 is a highly modular system for testing high-volume, commodity mixed-signal devices for the automotive, computer peripheral, telecom and wireless markets.

Harris Corp's Semiconductor unit makes discrete semiconductors and integrated circuits for the automotive, wireless communications, audio, multimedia, video and imaging, power control, power protection, and military markets.
In late trading, Teradyne was up 2-5/8 to 36 and Harris was up one to 82-5/8.
